name: Shanghai Jin Jiang International Hotels Co., Ltd.
summary: Shanghai Jin Jiang International Hotels Co., Ltd. operates and manages hotels in China and internationally. The company operates full service hotel under the Jin Jiang Radisson Hotels name, as well as J, Yan Garden, Kunlun, Jin Jiang, Radisson Collection, Radisson Blu, Radisson, Radisson Individuals, Park Plaz, and Golden Tulip brands; and limited service hotel under the Jin Jiang Hotels (China Region) name. It also provides food and catering services. The company was founded in 1935 and is headquartered in Shanghai, China.
